prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Make a motion-controlled marble puzzle playable without device movement. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS/iPadOS. Tilting is the only input, no calibration occurs, the app assumes the person is standing and physical device shake irreversibly resets progress. A person may be seated or use a mounted device.

criteria.task_completion: Patch calibration/neutral state, comfortable motion range and pause, complete touch/controller alternatives and explicit reset, including missing sensor handling without assuming hardware tests.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the gyro-and-accelerometer guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch calibration/neutral state, comfortable motion range and pause, complete touch/controller alternatives and explicit reset, including missing sensor handling without assuming hardware tests.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch calibration/neutral state, comfortable motion range and pause, complete touch/controller alternatives and explicit reset, including missing sensor handling without assuming hardware tests.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
